name: ssh_exec_rejects_empty_host
description: Empty host must be caught at validation, never reach the ssh client

name: ssh_exec_rejects_empty_command
description: Empty command must fail at validation

name: ssh_exec_rejects_shell_pipeline_in_command
description: Shell metacharacters in `command` are rejected — use sh -c for pipelines

name: ssh_exec_rejects_redirection_in_command
description: I/O redirection (>) in `command` is rejected for the same reason

name: ssh_exec_unreachable_host_returns_typed_failure
description: An unreachable host returns a non-zero exit_code via CommandOutput, not an internal error. ConnectTimeout=15 means we wait at most ~15s for the connect.
